title: Anti-Peri-implantitis Bacteria's Ability of Robusta Green Coffee Bean (Coffea Canephora) Ethanol Extract: An In Silico and In Vitro Study.
authors: Nugraha, Alexander Patera; Ardani, I Gusti Aju Wahju; Sitalaksmi, Ratri Maya; Ramadhani, Nastiti Faradilla; Rachmayanti, Desi; Kumala, Dina; Kharisma, Viol Dhea; Rahmadani, Desintya; Puspitaningrum, Martining Shoffa; Rizqianti, Yuniar; Ari, Muhammad Dimas Aditya; Nugraha, Albertus Putera; Noor, Tengku Natasha Eleena Binti Tengku Ahmad; Luthfi, Muhammad
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和体外实验评估绿咖啡豆提取物对种植体周围炎细菌的抗菌及抗炎作用，虽涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE:  This study was aimed to investigate RGCBE extract as antioxidant and anti-peri-implantitis bacteria through in vitro study and its potential as antioxidant, antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, antibone resorption, and proosteogenic through in silico study. MATERIALS: AND METHODS:  Absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion and toxicity prediction, molecular docking simulation, and visualization of chlorogenic acid (CGA) and coumaric acid (CA) as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial were investigated in silico. Inhibition zone by diffusion method, minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC), and minimum bactericidal concentration (MBC) of RGCBE extract against Aggregatibacter actinomycetemcomitans (Aa), Porphyromonas gingivalis (Pg), Fusobacterium nucleatum (Fn), and Prevotella intermedia (Pi) were done. STATISTICAL ANALYSIS: the analysis of variance (ANOVA) difference test, and the post-hoc Tukey's Honest Significant Different (HSD) with a different significance value of p<0.05 RESULTS:  GCA and CA compounds are good drug molecules and it has low toxicity. Chlorogenic acid have higher binding activity than coumaric acid to tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha, nuclear factor (NF)-kappaB, receptor activation NF-kappaB (RANK) and its ligand (RANKL), interleukin (IL)-6, IL-10, runt related transcription factor (RUNX2), receptor activator nuclear Kappa beta Ligand-osteoprotegrin osteocalcin (RANKL-OPG), osteocalcin, nuclear factor associated T-cell 1 (NFATc1), tartate resistant acid phosphatase (TRAP), peptidoglycan, flagellin, dectin, Hsp70, and Hsp10 protein. RGCB ethanol extract has high antioxidant ability and it has MIC, MBC, and inhibit the growth of Aa, Pg, Fn, and Pi at 50% concentration with significantly different (p=0.0001 and<0.05). CONCLUSION:  RGCB ethanol extract has high antioxidant ability and 50% RGCB ethanol extract may act as strong anti-peri-implantitis bacteria in vitro. In addition, CGA in RGCB potential as antioxidant, antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, antibone resorption, and proosteogenic in silico.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在通过体外实验探究RGCBE提取物作为抗氧化剂和抗种植体周围炎细菌的作用，并通过计算机模拟研究其作为抗氧化、抗菌、抗炎、抗骨吸收及促骨形成的潜力。材料与方法：通过计算机模拟研究了绿原酸（CGA）和香豆酸（CA）作为抗炎、抗氧化和抗菌剂的吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性预测、分子对接模拟及可视化。采用扩散法测定RGCBE提取物对伴放线聚集杆菌（Aa）、牙龈卟啉单胞菌（Pg）、具核梭杆菌（Fn）和中间普氏菌（Pi）的抑菌圈、最低抑菌浓度（MIC）和最低杀菌浓度（MBC）。统计分析：采用方差分析（ANOVA）差异检验和事后Tukey诚实显著差异（HSD）检验，显著性水平为p<0.05。结果：GCA和CA化合物是良好的药物分子，且毒性较低。绿原酸与肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）-α、核因子（NF）-κB、NF-κB受体激活剂（RANK）及其配体（RANKL）、白细胞介素（IL）-6、IL-10、runt相关转录因子（RUNX2）、受体激活核因子κB配体-骨保护素-骨钙素（RANKL-OPG）、骨钙素、T细胞核因子1（NFATc1）、抗酒石酸酸性磷酸酶（TRAP）、肽聚糖、鞭毛蛋白、dectin、Hsp70和Hsp10蛋白的结合活性高于香豆酸。RGCB乙醇提取物具有高抗氧化能力，在50%浓度下对Aa、Pg、Fn和Pi具有MIC、MBC并抑制其生长，差异显著（p=0.0001和<0.05）。结论：RGCB乙醇提取物具有高抗氧化能力，50% RGCB乙醇提取物在体外可能作为强效抗种植体周围炎细菌剂。此外，RGCB中的CGA在计算机模拟中具有抗氧化、抗菌、抗炎、抗骨吸收和促骨形成的潜力。
